_about: Settings for the runner on the New PC (NEW_PC_LEBRUN, HP OMEN 35L: Ryzen 9 9900X3D 12 cores, 64 GB, RTX 5080 16 GB), set up 23 November 2026. Keys here replace runner.json's. name: New PC runner
